PHASE_10_k1_object_candidates.logical_identity: the frozen K1 object candidates F_r, D_r, H_r (state-only polynomials, r = 0..4), and their suprema cert.sup[fam, r, 0] which TCT_INPUTS records as sup.{F,D,H}
PHASE_10_k1_object_candidates.note_from_the_frozen_source: aux_certifier: 'Every candidate is a state-only polynomial and is CONSTANT in e, so no term is lost by differentiating the candidates'
PHASE_10_k1_object_candidates.proof_of_existence: every one of the 63 objects in the sealed record carries its own `bernstein_calls` and `cpu_seconds`, which is direct evidence that the candidate was materialised and certified during the historical run

serialization_evidence.identity_gate_compares: record['objects'][name]['delta_mid'], record['eps_mid'], record['eps_cell'], auxiliary_evidence midpoint_eps / objects / candidate_suprema -- all SCALARS. No payload is compared because none is stored.

PHASE_10_k1_object_candidates.why: the object is absent from every store, but it is not missing DATA: it is a deterministic function of committed code and the committed cell spec, at an address the historical campaign already evaluated and adopted. tct_inputs.py's own docstring classifies exactly this recomputation as 'not a new real scientific evaluation'.
PHASE_10_k1_object_candidates.why_C6_must_not_perform_it: regeneration runs Aux3Certifier.prepare() + all_residuals(), i.e. Arb/Bernstein certification. That is NOT a purely deterministic serialization or materialization step, so the campaign instruction forbids C6 from running it. It also cannot run here: numpy and python-flint are absent.

PHASE_11_cover_refinement.question: can a finer cover at cell 309 be derived from existing certificates without recomputation?
PHASE_11_cover_refinement.whole_cell_refinement_is: a fixed-point iteration on the WHOLE cell (24 iterations, a contraction factor and a convergence flag), not a partition into sub-intervals
PHASE_11_cover_refinement.why: no sub-interval structure exists anywhere in the sealed record. A finer cover means certifying the objects on NEW, narrower cells, i.e. at scientific addresses that were never evaluated. Restriction of an existing whole-cell certificate to a sub-interval would not tighten it: the certificate's value IS the whole-cell supremum.
